Tilak Varma Run Out After Misunderstanding During Celebration

During a cricket match, batsman Tilak Varma was run out due to a misunderstanding about a boundary. While celebrating what was thought to be a four, Varma and his teammate Axar Patel became confused, leading to Varma's dismissal. The incident occurred during the third match, and video footage of the event has been shared.
